label: Return-target eligibility
title: Can a damaged Rule-54 pattern return on its own?
summary: Among seven spatial-rotation closures of nonconstant periodic orbits on a 12-cell Rule-54 ring, five have both one-bit injuries that return within four steps and injuries that do not.
takeaway: The smallest candidate has 36 early returns, 48 later returns and 12 injuries that never return; this establishes target eligibility, not self-repair or a useful controller.
